ev.q: In 2021, approximately one third (32.8%) of persons of all ages had a telemedicine appointment with a doctor, nurse, or other health professional during the past 12 months.
Percentage* of Persons Who Used Telemedicine During the Past 12 Months, † by Age Group
The percentage with a telemedicine appointment increased with age, from 17.2% among children aged <10 years to 45.5% among adults aged 70–79 years
Telemedicine use among adults aged ≥80 years was similar to that among adults aged 40–49, 50–59, and 60–69 years.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
